summary: The candidate adds a useful general comparison endpoint and its mapped/fused parameter logic passes focused CPU tests and an independent single-GPU numerical check. It remains a partial fix because checkpoint buffers are silently excluded, allowing a VAE-like live/disk state mismatch to report match=true, and an explicit empty module selection returns vacuous success.
